content:
[42895 Data Literacy | Subject description]
Credit points: 1

Data literacy, a critical skill for modern professionals, encompasses the ability to interpret, represent, and communicate data effectively. This subject introduces you to the essentials of data proficiency, preparing you for work in data-centric organisations and serving as a foundation for advanced study in data science, analytics, or statistics.

[42895 Data Literacy | Learning and teaching activities]
Microcredential presentation includes weekly synchronous one-hour online workshops facilitated by an expert UTS academic(s) supporting self-study and online (LMS) learning activities. Case studies of real-world business illustrate applications of data understanding techniques. The workshop sessions focus on hands-on experience in data understanding and interpretation. Regular formative activities throughout the semester will allow learners to gauge their progress.

title: Learning outcomes
content:
[42895 Data Literacy | Learning outcomes]
SLO1: Demonstrate an understanding and clearly communicate key concepts and relevant information from a data set. (D.1)
